parameters.query: SELECT * FROM findings WHERE finding_key = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM assets WHERE resource_id = $1 AND service = $2 LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM controls WHERE control_id = $1 AND framework = $2 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE findings SET risk_score=$2, priority=$3, sla_due=$4, repeated_failure=$5, updated_at=now()
WHERE finding_key=$1 RETURNING *;

triggerInfo: This workflow has no production triggers (Schedule, Webhook, Form, or Chat). It can only be executed in manual mode.
